crossRefs.note: Hear Yahweh’s word, you rulers of Sodom! Listen to the law of our God, you people of Gomorrah!
Yet for all this her treacherous sister, Judah, has not returned to me with her whole heart, but only in pretense,”…
Yahweh of Armies, the God of Israel says: “Add your burnt offerings to your sacrifices and eat meat.
How shall I come before Yahweh, and bow myself before the exalted God? Shall I come before him with burnt offerings…

people.name: Conaniah
people.line: Levite in charge of offerings during Hezekiah's reign

people.name: Hashabiah
people.line: A Levite leader during King Josiah's reign.

people.name: Jeiel
people.line: A Levite who contributed to Josiah's Passover celebration.

people.name: Jozabad
people.line: A Levite who contributed to the Passover celebration

people.name: Levi
people.line: Son of Jacob; progenitor of the Levites

translations.web: Conaniah also, and Shemaiah and Nethanel, his brothers, and Hashabiah, Jeiel, and Jozabad, the chiefs of the Levites, gave to the Levites for the Passover offerings five thousand small livestock and five hundred head of cattle.
translations.bsb: Additionally, Conaniah and his brothers Shemaiah and Nethanel, as well as Hashabiah, Jeiel, and Jozabad, officers of the Levites, contributed to the Levites 5,000 Passover offerings and 500 bulls.
translations.kjv: Conaniah also, and Shemaiah and Nethaneel, his brethren, and Hashabiah and Jeiel and Jozabad, chief of the Levites, gave unto the Levites for passover offerings five thousand small cattle, and five hundred oxen.
translations.asv: Conaniah also, and Shemaiah and Nethanel, his brethren, and Hashabiah and Jeiel and Jozabad, the chiefs of the Levites, gave unto the Levites for the passover-offerings five thousand small cattle, and five hundred oxen.
